Kids Box on European flights

We spoil our youngest passengers on European flights too – with the Onboard Delights Kids Box. The Kids Box contains a selection of child-appropriate, delicious snacks and can be easily pre-ordered up to 24 hours before departure for a fee.

Culinary Journey

Catering on board: tailored completely to your wishes

Journeys start with anticipation – including for the food and drinks you can enjoy on board. You can find all our culinary services in one place – transparent, personal and inspiring –  where you can experience a diverse, high-quality service that focuses on your personal wishes. Whether it’s small snacks or exquisite menus of an award-winning standard, you can look forward to a lavish selection offering you unforgettable taste experiences above the clouds.
